title: Linda Armas Tours · Initial agency experience
brief: Three static directions for a single travel agency based in San Cristóbal de las Casas: home, inquiry, staff workspace, quotation/PDF and image-and-text blog. Confirmed agency name; purple and fuchsia interface inspired by the official multicolor logo, with decorative turquoise, lime and orange. Travel content remains fictional; no production functionality.

artboards.title: Editorial journal
artboards.tradeoff: Strong storytelling and regional warmth; fewer offers visible at once.

artboards.title: Trip catalog
artboards.tradeoff: Fast discovery and comparison; less emphasis on long-form storytelling.

artboards.title: Advisor-led journey
artboards.tradeoff: Clear consultation process; less immediate catalog breadth.
